title: instrument.json (design_profile v7)
description: Instrument checks written by the v7 build-evaluator session: worst-case CPU time against the time limit, the noise of the official measure command, and which knobs move the score more than that noise.

max_cpu_s.description: Max CPU seconds of the current solution on the largest allowed inputs; null when not measured locally (v8 writes the file from official measures only).

time_limit_s.description: Time limit from the statement; null when the statement gives none.

speed_first.description: max_cpu_s is over 50% of time_limit_s: fix speed before tuning.

delta.description: Score at high minus score at low, other knobs unchanged.
